---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible TailTrail defect without sensitive data
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
---

## Reproduction

Describe the smallest reproducible case and the exact command used.

## Expected and actual behavior

Describe the expected result and the observed result.

## Environment

Include the TailTrail version, Python version, operating system, and host adapter.

## Redacted evidence

Attach only sanitized output. Do not include credentials, private code, customer data, PII, PHI, or private logs.
